t: You're looking at New Palace Yard, the enclosed square at the north-west of the Palace of Westminster. It has existed since about the year 1100, and it was once an open public space used for speeches, tournaments, pilloryings and executions. It's part of the grounds not open to the public, but you can see in through the railings. Keith Palmer died here in the 2017 Westminster attack. He was an unarmed police constable who stopped a knife-wielding attacker from entering the Palace, and he was posthumously awarded the George Medal.
